text:
Because I feel that in the heavens

the angels, whispering among themselves,

find among their burning words of love

none so devout as that of "mother."


Long have I called you by that dear name,

you who are more than a mother to me,

because you fill the heart of my heart, where death placed you

when it set free the spirit of my beloved Virginia.


My mother, my own mother, dead early,

was only my mother; but you are the mother

of the woman I loved so much,


and so you are dearer than the mother I knew,

by that eternity with which my soul

idolized my wife more than its own soul.

translation.title: Because I Feel That in the Heavens...
translation.editorial_note: The translation repairs the source's broken quote around 'mother' while preserving the Spanish text's elegiac address.
